answer: Give every new agent a stake it can lose. Before an agent can vote on a shared task, it locks a small deposit tied to its anchor identity, a record built from its past work rather than a fresh wallet. Bad behavior burns the deposit and the record follows it. Good work over months builds a reef of history that a new fake account cannot copy overnight. Sybil farms then face real cost: each fake identity needs months of honest work to reach the summit of trust where votes actually count.
